dataList.content:
A Faust posed a contemplative query.
浮士德中的一位提出了这样的思考。
"What, among all conceivable artwork, would constitute the true apogee of art—the one absolute piece that an artist could possibly create?" 一位艺术家所能创作出的，真正堪称究极的作品是什么？
And that singular inquiry is where the beginning of this Faust's record is situated. 这位浮士德的故事，便是从那个问题开始。

How do you find the intercostal musculature, Fascia?
肋骨周围的肌肉如何，法西娅？
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
Fragments of flesh, caged between plates of dull iron, quivered intermittently.
被夹在厚重的铁板间的血肉不时颤抖。

The heart melodized an arrhythmic cadence, while the vasculature, arborizing in no particular order, convulsed and twitched liberally.
心脏以奇妙的节拍在搏动，向周围无序地延伸出去的血管随之不断蠕动。

The thing gave no response. Or perhaps "could not respond" would be a more precise statement,
它没有作出回答。不，应该说是无法作出回答吧。

as no apparatus capable of producing vocal timbres was attached to the construct.
因为那构造体上不存在任何振动器官。

And yet, to Faust, the thing's corporal oscillations seemed to come across as some sort of parsable linguistic discourse. She was, after all, nodding her head to it, all the while focusing her gaze on the mass of twitching muscles as one would on a person with whom one is engaged in a particularly lovely conversation.
但这样的跳动在浮士德眼中似乎能被解读为某种语言。她一边用沉静深邃的眼神凝视着那块肌肉，一边不断点头。

I see. But I no longer have much flesh left to give. It's a pity to have to make this request to you, but please temper your cravings for a short while.
这样吗。但我剩下的肉片也不多了。虽然很遗憾，但还需要请你稍作忍耐。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
The cerebrum...? Oh, I'm afraid that necessitates further study. For now, only segments that are nonessential to Faust's continued existence have been excised.
灰质吗……还需要稍微再考虑一下。现在切掉的都是对浮士德的维持没有影响的部分。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
... There is no certainty to be had yet.
……还不能确定。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
Faust delivered her words in a remarkably amicable tone as her hands worked without rest.
浮士德用柔和的语气回答，手上不断忙碌着。

With a razor-sharp scalpel in one hand and forceps in the other, she methodically pushed the blade through the incision on her abdomen. An uninformed observer would think she were carrying out a surgical procedure on herself.
她一手拿着锋利的手术刀，另一手拿着镊子，将其不断伸入自己敞开的腹部，看上去像是在给自己做手术。

If one were permitted a closer look, however, one would soon learn that the prodding and slicing of the flesh more closely resembled the measured enthusiasm of a gourmet slicing her choice cut of meat in a haute-cuisine affair—the colorless passion on her face made such an interpretation even more convincing.
用镊子轻轻夹住肉片，将其切成适合食用的大小，正完成着这一切的浮士德面带热切的表情，简直像是在高级餐厅用餐一般。

In return, the cut will be made along the vertical grain this time. You will find it more efficient to absorb and assimilate.
作为代替，这次我会沿着肌纤维的纹理进行纵向切割，这样吸收起来会更加方便。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
With this, Fascia, all constituent elements of Faust's corpus—excluding the cephalic region—have been transferred to you.
这样一来，除颈部以上的部分外，构成浮士德身体的其余要素就全部转移到你身上了，法西娅。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
Faust's observation does justice to the present state of being. The only remaining human tissue within that "body" is now a brain with partially degraded function.
正如浮士德所言，尚残存于那具肉体中的人体组织，仅剩下已失去部分功能的大脑。
At this point, the pronoun "I" might as well represent the greatsword designated as "Fascia" in all but name. 这样想来，或许现在说我的存在实际是那把名为法西娅的大剑才是正确的。

... Perhaps this very same impression is one that Faust wished to inspire through Fascia, who will one day be exhibited on a pedestal for her audience to appraise.
……那位浮士德似乎希望此后观赏法西娅的观众会产生这样的想法。

... Hmm. As expected, Faust's ability to construct an impromptu dialogue has measurably declined following the excision of brain slices last time.
嗯……果然，组织实时对话的能力多少有些下降。对不起，法西娅。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
Sorry, Fascia. Your absorption of the corpus ought to be accompanied by a more stimulating conversation...
必须要讲些更有意思的故事来度过这段身体吸收的时间。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
The wait won't be long, though. A critique symposium is scheduled for today with the other Apprentices.
但今天也要和其他子辈们一起进行讨论会，所以请稍等一下。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
It did require some degree of effort to convince those laypeople who have no interest in this study of art, but...
费了很大力气才说服这些对这一领域不感兴趣的人……
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
Ah...! Y-Young Faust.
啊……！浮、浮士德。
dataList.title:
The Index Apprentice
食指 子辈

dataList.content:
How puzzling. Faust does not recall extending an invitation to Don Quixote.
奇怪。浮士德这次没有邀请堂吉诃德小姐。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
V-verily, that is... I did ch-chance to overhear thee c-conversing with another Apprentice... a-and... uh, I, too, have a g-goodly store of s-stories for thee, so... Hehe...
那、那个……吾听闻了其他子、子辈间之交谈……吾、吾也知晓许多上、上佳的故事……嘿、嘿嘿。
dataList.title:
The Index Apprentice
食指 子辈

dataList.content:
F-few there be that lend an ear to m-my words... and I y-yet have many a tale to recount about Fixers. F-forsooth, the thirst for the lore of Fixers is not s-sated easily, no matter h-how much one learneth...
并无许多人愿意聆听吾之故事……吾还有许多收、收尾人的故事呢。这方面的知识，积累再多、再多……也不够。
dataList.title:
The Index Apprentice
食指 子辈

dataList.content:
... Are the others on their way?
……其他子辈还在来这里的路上吗？
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
Hm...? Oh, I-I sh-shan't say I'm certain...
嗯？啊……吾、吾不曾知晓……
dataList.title:
The Index Apprentice
食指 子辈

dataList.content:
Th-they grant me not m-much time to converse with them, so... Y-Young Ishmael and Sinclair d-did seem to contend in a d-duel of words, and, uh...
以实玛利和辛克莱正忙于相互争执……其、其余的各位……与吾、吾之交流实为稀少……
dataList.title:
The Index Apprentice
食指 子辈

dataList.content:
I... see.
我……明白了。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
This Faust directed a brief, apologetic look toward Fascia, which was pulsating with a stronger beat next to her.
这位浮士德充满歉意地向身旁不断搏动着的法西娅投去视线。

The Apprentice designated as Don Quixote had, for several months, been persistently visiting Faust and Fascia uninvited, telling streams of wild tales that ended neither here nor there.
实际上，那位名为堂吉诃德的子辈从数月前开始，就一直不断前来拜访，给浮士德和法西娅讲各种各样的故事。

At first, Faust found an intellectual satisfaction in discovering that a singular thematic axis of "Fixers" could generate thousands of narrative variations, and that there was plenty of new information to be garnered from Don Quixote's tales...
开始时，仅就收尾人这一题材就能讲出几千种故事，而且每次都能从中获得一些新的情报，浮士德对此也十分满意。

... However, it wasn't long before Faust learned that the pieces of information overlapped in the multiple variations of those stories. Faust decided redundancy was best left unentertained.
……但随着重复的情报越来越多，最终就连浮士德都退缩了。

Approximately an hour remains until the Maestro's lecture. You may tell your story... but please see that it ends before.
离大师的授课还有一个小时左右，在那之前……就请你讲吧。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
H-huzzah! I-I shall not d-disappoint...!
呀……吼！吾明白了……！
dataList.title:
The Index Apprentice
食指 子辈

dataList.content:
Faust had no choice but to listen in silence.
束手无策。只能默默聆听。

That is, until the time finally arrived...
……就这样，终于。

... for the practical session of her art.
实践课程的时间到了。

There, Fascia. Your coat is taken off. Absorb as much as you can.
已经帮你把上衣脱下来了，尽量多地吸收吧，法西娅。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
Please do as the entity designated as Faust did—in her hunger, she absorbed every piece of knowledge she came across. So must you with your pieces of corpus.
像名为浮士德的个体一样，不断贪求和吸收知识……像那样去做就好。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
They moved through rows and rows of specimens—slicing, tearing, and absorbing.
在成群的素体之间穿行，不断斩切、剥落、吸收的时间。

Fascia's heart pulsed louder and hotter, while Faust, in tandem with Fascia's hunger, synchronized her movements. It was a vivacious waltz.
随着法西娅心脏的搏动不断变得更加炽热，浮士德以更为轻快的步调加以配合。

Oh, you have grown so much in such a short span of time. A restaging is in order...!
这段时间以来你竟已有了这种程度的成长吗。那么，将于此次再度进行现场展示……！
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
Yes, Fascia. Your performance is most excellent. Faust would have elected the same course of action.
是的，浮士德也会像那样做吧。做得好，法西娅。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
Faust never stopped talking to Fascia, even as an entire specimen was being sectioned and grafted onto Fascia.
即便在对一具素体进行切割和黏贴时，浮士德也没有停下与法西娅的交谈。

The tremors of Fascia's musculature almost seem to function as a coherent language now.
此刻的情景，真的会令人产生那肌肉的颤抖似乎能够发挥某种语言功能的错觉。
It's almost... human. 会觉得……那简直就是人类。

... Alas, such a designation is still too premature.
但还并非如此。

You see, Fascia...
法西娅，你看。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
... Many in the City believe that the brain alone suffices for the "human" classification, regardless of any other modifications applied to the corpus.
在都市之中，只要大脑还存在，无论其他部分被替代为怎样的形态，都会有人将其作为“人类”来看待。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
You now possess the entirety of Faust's blood and flesh. But in the absence of a brain, you are not perceived as human, even though 90% of the physical composition that constitutes Faust—a "human"—resides in you.
你虽然拥有浮士德的全部血肉，但却没有大脑……虽然拥有九成构成浮士德这一人类的要素，却不能被称为人类。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
Faust has only the brain... and Fascia lacks only the brain.
只剩下大脑的浮士德……和只缺少大脑的法西娅。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
Faust is confident that this artwork will, from its thematic inquiry alone, yield far more than a passing grade from the Maestro. For both evaluation of the assignment and appreciation of the piece, of course.
事实上，浮士德认为，这种程度的题材不仅在作为课题方面，连作品本身也会得到极高的评价。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
But... Faust can't help but remain curious:
但……浮士德仍然很好奇。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
If all of the components constituting Faust's corpus are present in a given object, only arranged in a structure and form different from Faust's original corpus... Would such a thing still be called "Faust"?
虽然其拥有构成浮士德所需的一切，但鉴于配置与形态上的不同，是否还能称其为浮士德。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
Your name may be "Fascia" at the moment, Fascia... but in the near future, once the day of your exhibition finally comes, your pedestal will bear another name: "Artwork: Faust?" with the question mark.
虽然你现在被称呼为法西娅……但在不远的未来，当你被展出的那一天到来，在下方所贴的标签上，你的作品名应该被标为《浮士德？》。
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
A Faust at some point in the future will apply her final touch to the masterpiece.
某一日浮士德将会落下对这件作品的最后一笔。

But if even the brain, the final remnant of Faust's corpus, is transferred to Fascia... Will it remain Fascia, or will it become Faust?
但将全部的大脑都转移至名为法西娅之物体内的瞬间，它还是法西娅吗？还是说应该是浮士德呢。

Would it become human in the eyes of the City?
在都市的眼中，它会被当作人类吗？

Or...
还是……

Finding herself unable to arrive at a clear answer, the smile on Faust's face grows even more pronounced,
做出回答并不容易，浮士德脸上的微笑因此更加深邃起来。

along with the conviction that this here, this mystery, this query—is precisely the unique brand of aesthetics that she has been pursuing all along.
这同时也加深了她对自身所追求的美学正是如此的信念。

An artwork through which the self becomes the self by means of total self-consumption.
通过将自我完全消耗的方式，来塑就自我的作品。

The one true magnum opus that an artist could create only once in her life, alone in its uniqueness.
作为艺术家的生命中所能创作出的，唯一完整的作品。

Even today, in this very moment, Faust stands in anticipation of the day that is yet to come, quietly mouthing the word that her future self, if not some observer before the pedestal, would whisper in wonder:
今天的浮士德在心中不断描摹着那一天——不断地模仿着未来的自己，或是站在作品前的某人口部的动作。

"... Faust...?"
浮……士德？
dataList.title:
The Ring Apprentice
环指 子辈

dataList.content:
With a question mark.
如此说道。
